name: State Government Open Merit Scholarship.
description: Sanction Set - 1208 Students Admited in Arts Commerce Science Law Graduation are eligible for application For Fresh - Candidate must secure 60 Percentage in 12th standard New sanction process done through DHE office and Renewal sanction process done through joint director office of concern colleges. Selection of Candidates Is on Merit basis

criteria.label: The applicant must be a resident of the Maharashtra State.

evidence.quote: The applicant must be a resident of the Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: Need to get at least 60 percent in 12th standard.

evidence.quote: Need to get at least 60 percent in 12th standard.

criteria.label: Only applicable for stream Arts, commerce, science and law.

benefits.text:
( As Per GR Dated 16.11.1964)
Rs. 100 per month to student bank account.
Selection of Candidates Is on Faculty wise (Arts/ Commerce/science etc.) Merit basis

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
